description: This bar chart illustrates the relationship between the variable ‘m’ and the metric ‘MAP@10’. The horizontal axis, labeled “m”, displays categories numbered 6 through 10 in ascending order, with no specified scale type. The vertical axis, labeled “MAP@10”, represents values on a linear scale ranging from 23.0 to 27.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.5. Two sets of bars are presented for each value of ‘m’: a purple set labeled “Uniform Sampling Strategy” and a yellow set. The purple bars decrease in height from approximately 26.8 for m=6 to 26.2 for m=10, with exact values of 26.8, 26.6, 26.4, 26.3, and 26.2 respectively. The yellow bars also decrease in height from approximately 25.4 for m=6 to 24.8 for m=10, with exact values of 25.4, 25.1, 24.9, 24.8, and 24.8 respectively. The bars are arranged in pairs, with the purple bar for each ‘m’ value positioned adjacent to the corresponding yellow bar. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
